lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Honey,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I have a favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Are you free today?
Sorry, but I'm busy.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Are you now?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Truly?
Yes.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What a bummer.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I thought you of all people

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: would be willing to help me.
Can't you just ask someone else?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You're the only one who can help me, Honey.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'll make it worth your while.
... Fine.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I knew you wouldn't leave me hanging high and dry!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I need you to buy me some cosmetics.
What kind?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It's only on sale for a limited time,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: and I've got a lot on my plate right now.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I've been dying to get my hands on this, so could you please get it for me?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'll tell you exactly what it is you need to get.
This sounds like something anyone could do for you. Why me specifically?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: If this were any ordinary make-up, then you'd be right.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: This, however, is special.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm only going to use it when I'm with you.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: As you can see, I can hardly entrust anyone else with such an important task.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Please, and thank you!
I feel like I've been tricked.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hey, don't talk like that!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Also, if you're even a little bit late, they'll be out of stock,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: so get a move on!
